snippet.title: NABERON – Official Trailer | Real-time space strategy with ground battles
snippet.description:
NABERON is a real-time space strategy game with planetary ground battles, made by a single developer and inspired by Imperium Galactica II.

Explore an unknown galaxy, colonize planets, design your own ships and tanks, and fight for every world — in orbit and on the surface. Play alone or online with friends.

🎮 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5162720/NABERON/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=trailer
🚀 Free demo: Steam Next Fest, October 19, 2026
🖥 Windows | Full English and Hungarian (text and voice)

Made with Unity. Music: original. Some assets were created with AI tools and reworked by hand.

—
A NABERON valós idejű űrstratégia bolygófelszíni harccal, az Imperium Galactica II ihlette, egyetlen fejlesztő munkája. Teljes magyar felirattal és magyar hanggal. Ingyenes demó októberben a Steamen.

#RTS #4X #spacestrategy #indiegame #ImperiumGalactica #Steam #NextFest
